examples.text: We stayed in a really mangy hotel in New York.

glosses: Cheap, low-quality building material, especially as that used to make conventional suburban housing of a uniform design.

examples.text: And the boys go into business, and marry and raise a family / In boxes made of ticky-tacky, and they all look just the same.

glosses: Made of this material; cheaply built, of low quality.

examples.text: My first impression was that Phoenix was another American Dream (a la L.A.) come true—ticky-tacky tract housing complexes and mini-malls stretching boundlessly into the flat desert horizon.

It almost seems that major discipline problems take care of themselves; it is the day-to-day little ticky-tacky issues that bind and scratch and itch until you find that you are boxed in with a class that you can no longer control.
